net25pct.note: '25% NET RATES' — presumed 25% off the RSP/rack rate below (mapping not explicitly stated as a formula in-document, but arithmetic is broadly consistent).

rspRackRate.note: 'RSP' rate sheet, labeled RACK RATES in the source document.

mandatoryExtrasAllMonths.note: All passengers must pay landing fee + community development levy as an extra, on top of the flight rate. Medical evacuation cover is automatically added to the invoice unless the client confirms they already have their own cover.

notes: Clients staying outside the Masai Mara Reserve who enter specifically for ballooning and depart after breakfast are no longer required to purchase a park ticket. A game drive after the flight does require a park ticket if not already held.
Park fees / landing fees or their governing rules may change at short notice.
All passengers must sign an indemnity document before flight.

skippedFiles.reason: Pure logistics (pickup times/drive durations per lodge/camp) — no pricing.
